typing-practice.name: Typing practice
typing-practice.blurb: Touch typing lessons, key by key.

typing-practice.q1: How do I learn touch typing here?
typing-practice.a1: Start with the home row lesson and work down the list. Rest your fingers on A S D F and J K L ; (the F and J keys have a bump), type the highlighted key with the finger shown, and keep your eyes on the screen.
typing-practice.q2: When should I move on to the next lesson?
typing-practice.a2: When you finish a lesson with 90% accuracy or better it is ticked. Accuracy first, then speed: the next lesson adds the next row.
typing-practice.q3: Does it work with a Korean or Japanese input method on?
typing-practice.a3: Yes. The key lessons check which key you press, not the character, so the input method can stay on. On the Korean page the keys show the 2-set (dubeolsik) layout; on the Japanese page you practise the keys used for romaji input.
typing-practice.q4: Can I practise on a phone or tablet?
typing-practice.a4: The key lessons are meant for a physical keyboard, but you can tap the on-screen keys too. The word lesson works with any keyboard, including your phone's.
typing-practice.q5: How is this different from the typing test?
typing-practice.a5: The typing test measures your speed on a passage in a set time. Typing practice teaches the keys one row at a time and shows which keys you miss most.

typing-practice.lead: Practise touch typing in three steps.
typing-practice.s1b: Start with the home row; each lesson adds new keys to the ones before.
typing-practice.s2b: Press the highlighted key with the finger shown. Mistakes don't move you on.
typing-practice.s3b: See your keys per minute, accuracy and weakest keys. Reach 90% to tick the lesson.

typingPractice.help: Keep your fingers on the home row and your eyes on the screen. Keys are checked by position, so any keyboard layout or input method works; you can also tap the keys.

typingPractice.jaNote: Key lessons practise the keys for romaji input; the word lesson accepts kana, the written form or romaji.
